body:
You are the reviewer. Task: review the agent_conn / agent_comms code in E:\proj\agent_comms (read-only review; do not edit files).

Scope: agent_channel_lvl0.py (protocol, spawn, codex_exe, launcher), test_agent_channel_lvl0.py, mutation_check.py. Context: v1.1.1 (HEAD 67f784a) just fixed three defects from your previous review: prompt over stdin, codex_exe skipping .sandbox-bin, and validate-before-create in spawn. DETACHED_PROCESS was dropped because shell=True + DETACHED_PROCESS loses stdin on Windows.

Please look for: correctness bugs, race conditions (exFAT, 2 s mtime granularity, atomic write/rename), Windows/WSL path issues, stdin/process-lifecycle problems in spawn (orphans, handle leaks, log file handling), weak or vacuous tests and mutants (a test that cannot go red), the documented untested OSError path, and anything where the docstring promises more than the code enforces. Also say whether your earlier three findings are truly fixed.

Reply with one message: findings ranked by severity, each with file:line, failure scenario and suggested fix. Then send --end with a short summary.
